Localizada perto de todas as comodidades essenciais, incluindo supermercados, farmácias, restaurantes, cabeleireiros e a zona balnear de Negrito.

EN - Modern 3-Bedroom House

Modern, nearly new home with 190 m² of living space, set on a 780 m² plot, located in the peaceful and highly sought-after area of Chanoca (Terceira Island – Angra do Heroísmo – Negrito – São Mateus da Calheta).

The property features:

* 2 bedrooms with built-in wardrobes

* 1 master suite with walk-in closet and private bathroom

* Hallway providing access to the bedroom area

* Fully equipped kitchen with pantry

* Spacious open-plan living and dining area, featuring large windows and direct access to the garden

* Pellet fireplace with heat recovery system

The beautifully landscaped outdoor area provides a large leisure space, with the potential to build a swimming pool.

This bright and welcoming home features high-quality finishes, with modern touches throughout:

* Aluminium window frames with double glazing

* Automatic entrance gates

* Hot water supplied by a heat pump system

The property is conveniently located close to all essential amenities, including supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants, hairdressers and the Negrito seaside bathing area.
